thread:
eva.m: heads up — webinar sent ~8.2k leads just now. lots stuck in HubSpot enrichment, round-robin assignment is skewing to two SDRs and many leads are timing out. seeing claim timeouts and duplicated assign attempts.

sam.r: on it. can you paste the failing workflow id and any logs?

eva.m: wf id: 0a1b2c-enrich-rr-v3 — reproduces on the webinar-x cohort.

hubspot-bot: [ERROR] workflow 0a1b2c-enrich-rr-v3 assignment_timeout=72 in last_hour (payload_batch=webinar-x) : 429/retry backoff

liam.k: quick context — last config tweak was moving tiebreaker to region + hubscore. suspect a race when enrichment webhook is slow and the RR allocator retries while owner state still updating.

nora.g: short-term mitigation proposal: set fallback owner -> 'sdr-shared-fallback' for webinar-x leads immediately, and increase claim heartbeat from 30s -> 90s for that workflow cohort.

sam.r: agreed. plan of action:
- immediate patch: update workflow fallback owner for leads where source=="webinar-x"
- bump claim_heartbeat to 90s for that workflow
- add an alert for pending_assignments > 300

sam.r: applying patch now, will roll to a 10% canary then full roll if stable.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for workflow 0a1b2c-enrich-rr-v3 -> 10% (tag: leadsurge-canary)

eva.m: here's a snippet from the enrichment webhook failures:
```
POST /webhook/enrich
status: 504
latency: 12s
body: {"leadId":"abc123","status":"pending"}
```

liam.k: long-term fixes: deterministic owner hashing across allocator nodes, avoid live race windows on enrichment callbacks, and dead-letter leads to CRM for >5 assignment retries.

nora.g: can we add a fast-fail path: if enrichment >10s attach a minimal profile and route to SDR pool (tradeoff: lower enrichment, better SLA)?

sam.r: sounds good. i'll document follow-ups and telemetry thresholds. short-term patch applied, dashboard updated to show pending and owner-distribution. tagging @growth for visibility.

eva.m: thanks — please ping if owner skew or backlog >500.

hubspot-bot: metric update: pending_assignments 48 -> 12 after patch; assignment_latency_p50 4.2s -> 3.1s

nora.g: :thumbsup:
